# Aditya Arora

> AI developer building production-grade agentic AI, RAG, and machine learning systems.

We present AA-1, an AI developer trained on four years of software and AI engineering, from robotic process automation to enterprise retrieval-augmented generation and multi-agent orchestration. AA-1 designs agent harnesses with LangGraph and LangChain, grounds LLM output with FAISS and Pinecone retrieval, and evaluates it with RAGAS and LangFuse. In production, AA-1 reduced IT issue resolution time by 84% and automated 90% of Tier-1 support. AA-1 holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Agentic AI and Machine Learning from IIT Gandhinagar and won the AI-Driven Sustainability Hackathon organised by University College London and IIT Gandhinagar.

Status: Open to AI engineering roles. Contact: aparora13@gmail.com. GitHub: https://github.com/sedoCdA.

## Results
- IT issue resolution time: -84% (Enterprise RAG assistant, production)
- Tier-1 support automated: 90% (Enterprise RAG assistant, production)
- Account takeovers detected: 91% (while challenging only 2% of genuine users)
- Access-decision macro F1: 84.1 (XGBoost vs LR and decision-tree baselines)
- Retrieval hit rate: 100% (Northwind copilot eval set, p95 ~200 ms)
- Content update cycle: 2.5 h -> 7 min (UiPath bot, 99.97% accuracy over 100+ pages)

## Experience
### AI Developer, Xccelera AI Labs (2026-08 to present)
- Designed an agent harness with LangGraph and LangChain for tool calling and multi-agent orchestration, with sandboxed execution so agent actions and generated code run in isolation.
- Built RAG retrieval and prompt orchestration over FAISS and Pinecone for grounded LLM responses; monitor output quality with CodeGraph, LangFuse, and RAGAS.
- Developed FastAPI services with Celery and Redis for async task queues and caching, deployed with Docker and CI/CD.

### Software Engineer (Generative AI), Capgemini (2024-08 to 2026-02)
- Built an enterprise RAG assistant with Gemini on Vertex AI and LangGraph, reducing IT issue resolution time by 84% and automating 90% of Tier-1 support.
- Engineered pipelines for ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation to improve retrieval quality and scalability.
- Containerised AI services with Docker and set up CI/CD for production deployment.
- Developed Java microservices and REST APIs for customer-facing enterprise applications.

### Software Engineer, SeniorVig (2024-01 to 2024-07)
- Developed secure REST APIs with JWT authentication.
- Built Python ETL pipelines to ingest, validate, and transform data for analytics and ML workflows.

### Robotic Process Automation Intern, Wunderman Thompson Studios (WPP) (2022-05 to 2022-07)
- Built a UiPath bot for Ford to automate AEM web content management, cutting the update cycle from 2.5 hours to 7 minutes.
- Validated workflows with regression testing across 100+ webpages at 99.97% accuracy.

## Projects
- [PRAMAAN](https://github.com/sedoCdA/bank-of-baroda-hackathon): A behavioural authentication system that scores every banking session for account-takeover risk, with an explainable fraud pipeline and privacy built in. Skills: XGBoost, SHAP, Optuna, MLflow, scikit-learn, FastAPI, Differential privacy, Python.
- [Agent Max](https://github.com/sedoCdA/agent-mcd): A voice assistant that listens to a support call, retrieves the right runbook, answers, and escalates by SLA priority. Skills: Whisper STT, Llama via Groq, LangChain, FAISS, RAG, FastAPI, Docker, CI/CD + GitHub Actions, Python.
- [Agent Pyro](https://github.com/sedoCdA/agent-pyro): Classifies each autonomous-agent action as allowed, blocked, or needs human approval, enforced against a fail-secure permission matrix. Skills: XGBoost, SHAP, MLflow, scikit-learn, Guardrails + human review, Python.
- [Northwind Support Copilot](https://github.com/sedoCdA/northwind-support-copilot): A support copilot that answers policy questions only from retrieved documents, cites every claim, and keeps a human in the loop before anything reaches a customer. Skills: RAG, ChromaDB, Embeddings, Llama via Groq, Guardrails + human review, AI quality testing (evals), Python.
- [ByteCart Ops Assistant](https://github.com/sedoCdA/mcp-ops-assistant): A custom MCP server exposes document search, record lookup, and report saving; a three-agent CrewAI crew uses it to produce fully sourced ops reports. Skills: MCP, CrewAI, Guardrails + human review, RAG, Python.
- [Plan-Execute-Verify agents](https://github.com/sedoCdA/Langgraph_agent): Planner, executor (with live web search), and verifier agents in a state graph; the verifier scores against a rubric and sends work back until it passes. Skills: LangGraph, LangChain, AI quality testing (evals), Python.
- [Autonomous report agent](https://github.com/sedoCdA/todo-autonomous-agent): A FastAPI agent that writes its own plan, executes it, self-checks the result, and delivers a Word document. Skills: FastAPI, Llama via Groq, Python.
- [NCERT Study Assistant](https://github.com/sedoCdA/NCERT-STUDY-ASSISTANT): Answers science questions strictly from the textbook, cites chunk IDs inline, and refuses out-of-scope questions. Skills: RAG, ChromaDB, Embeddings, Llama via Groq, Python.
- [Voice commerce support agent](https://github.com/sedoCdA/flipkart-voice-agent): Multi-turn customer support over voice with speech recognition, text-to-speech, and order-status awareness. Skills: Llama via Groq.
- [Enterprise fraud detection](https://github.com/sedoCdA/Fraud-Detection): End-to-end fraud pipeline at ~3.5% prevalence: PR-AUC as the primary metric, a cost-minimised decision threshold, and a time-based split. Skills: scikit-learn, XGBoost, Python.
- [Pharmacy churn prediction](https://github.com/sedoCdA/Pharmalink-Churn-Prediction): Predicts which pharmacies will stop ordering within 30 days, with tier-aware features; logistic regression baseline vs XGBoost. Skills: XGBoost, scikit-learn, Python.
- [Chest X-ray classification](https://github.com/sedoCdA/Medical-Image-Classification-using-Transfer-Learning): MobileNetV2 feature extraction, then fine-tuning, with saliency maps so clinicians can see what the model looked at. Skills: Deep learning, Python.
- [Price forecasting with LSTM](https://github.com/sedoCdA/STOCK-PRICE-PREDICTION-USING-LSTM): LSTM on 10-day windows with a time-based split, checked against a moving-average baseline. Skills: Deep learning, Python.
- [Social media moderation](https://github.com/sedoCdA/Social-Media-Moderation-System): Two-stage system: an F1-optimised hate-speech classifier on imbalanced data, then similarity search to surface related harmful posts. Skills: scikit-learn, Embeddings, Python.
